description: Export the contracts — ALL types (rental, service, maintenance, lease, insurance, …) unless contract_type narrows it — as an Excel file (Vertraege-<date>.xlsx; Mietvertraege-… with contract_type=rental). Sheets: Verträge (one row per contract: type, status, our role, our company, counterparty, linked organisation and person, then the extracted fields incl. calculated €/m² for rentals, then one column per custom field); the tenant's own sheets from set_contract_scan_rules.export_sheets, if any (each contract on the sheet that matches its 'blatt' custom field, with the columns defined there); Fristen (every deadline by date); Zu prüfen (low-confidence fields, contradictions, unreadable pages, unassigned files); Dateien (every file and its contract). Optional: scan_id (adds unassigned files of that scan), only_extracted (default true), write_to {bridge, folder, path} — also writes the .xlsx into that folder on the connected computer. Returns a download link (7 days).

contract_type.description: Only contracts of this type, e.g. rental

only_extracted.description: Only contracts with extracted facts (default true)

write_to.description: Also write the .xlsx into this folder on a connected computer

bridge.description: Bridge slug of the connected computer

name: export_contracts_excel
